extensionName.message: Cache Miss Fix for restored tabs

extensionDescription.message: Repairs tabs that come back as ERR_CACHE_MISS after Chrome restores a session, staggered per site so protected pages are not rate limited.

popupRetryAll.message: Retry the tabs I gave up on

optionsSubtitle.message: Chrome restores background tabs from its cache. Pages behind Cloudflare are sent with no-store, so nothing was cached and the restore fails with ERR_CACHE_MISS — only the foreground tab gets a real network load. This extension notices those failures and re-navigates the tabs, one site at a time.

fieldEnabledHint.message: Turn off to keep the extension installed but idle.

fieldShowBadge.message: Show a badge while tabs are being fixed

fieldShowBadgeHint.message: The badge counts tabs waiting or currently reloading.

fieldLogLevelHint.message: Debug and trace are useful when reporting a problem.

fieldMaxAttemptsHint.message: After this many failed reloads the error page is left alone.

fieldStagger.message: Delay between reloads of the same site

fieldStaggerHint.message: Reloading many tabs of one protected site at once invites a challenge or a rate limit. 1500 ms is a good default.

fieldNetworkErrorsHint.message: Includes timeouts, resets and HTTP/2 protocol errors. Off by default, because these often mean the network really is unavailable.

fieldStartupOnly.message: Only act shortly after the browser starts

fieldStartupOnlyHint.message: Limits the fix to the session-restore window.

fieldPreemptive.message: Load known problem sites from the network when a restored tab is first opened

fieldPreemptiveHint.message: Prevents the error page instead of repairing it, but costs a network load even when the cache would have worked. Applies to sites this extension already had to fix, and to the lists below.

fieldAllowlistHint.message: One host per line. Leave empty to cover every site. Subdomains are included.

fieldDenylistHint.message: One host per line. Always wins over the list above.

preventiveIntro.message: Instead of repairing a failed restore, this rewrites the Cache-Control header of the listed sites' pages so Chrome is allowed to cache them — then the restore succeeds on its own, with no reload.

preventiveWarning.message: Trade-off: the page HTML of these sites, including pages you are signed in to, is written to the browser cache on disk, and a restored tab may briefly show content up to the chosen age. Only add sites you are comfortable caching.

fieldCacheableEnabled.message: Rewrite Cache-Control for the sites below

fieldCacheableDomainsHint.message: One host per line. Each needs permission to read and modify its responses.

fieldCacheableMaxAge.message: How long a restored page may be reused

permissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted, so no rules are active.
